outcome: use of VA mental health care
receipt of prescription opioids during pregnancy
use of complementary and integrative health approaches
cohort: 172 pregnant veterans with MSK pain and 1,009 pregnant veterans without MSK pain identified from an existing cohort of 1,181 veterans who delivered a newborn before June 1, 2021
finding: Pregnant veterans with MSK pain were more likely to be diagnosed with mental health conditions, use VA mental health care, and receive prescription opioids during pregnancy compared to pregnant veterans without MSK pain.
mod_finding: Pregnant veterans with MSK pain were more likely to deliver by cesarean section compared to pregnant veterans without MSK pain.
